title: Security and ChatGPT lab series
summary: Upper-level information-security students use ChatGPT across laboratory tasks on phishing, access control, cryptography, host hardening, and web security. Students generate security artifacts, inspect AI-assisted attacks and defenses, and consider legal and ethical implications.

sources.title: Teaching Security in the Era of Generative AI: A Course Design of Security + ChatGPT

locator.section: IV. The Design of the Information Security Course

sources.evidence_quote: In the second lab, students use ChatGPT to craft an email ... resulting a phishing email as a proof-of-concept.

assessment.summary: Complete a sequence of hands-on security labs that use ChatGPT for offensive, defensive, and automation tasks.
student_actions: Craft and detect phishing emails with ChatGPT.
Generate a BYOD policy with password and multifactor-authentication requirements.
Use ChatGPT for cryptographic operations and flaw detection.
Generate web and port-scanning code and inspect JavaScript for security issues.

student_role.description: Students use ChatGPT to generate and inspect offensive and defensive security artifacts.
